title: Surreal Moonlit Symphony
description: A skeletal musician wearing a crown and blue robes sits at a grand piano on a floating stone platform in a turbulent sea. A woman with long turquoise hair stands beside him holding sheet music while a red bird flies toward the piano, all beneath a glowing blue smiling moon and a twisted glowing tree.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a crowned skeleton in blue robes playing a grand piano on a stone platform floating in a stormy dark blue ocean. A woman with long flowing turquoise hair stands beside him holding musical score. A bright red bird flies toward the piano with a laser beam. Behind them grows a large glowing turquoise tree with hanging papers. A giant smiling blue moon with a face illuminates the night sky filled with clouds and floating musical notes.
